changeSet.author: muw-ophthalmology
changeSet.comment: Give every inference job the file it came from.

changeSet.author: muw-ophthalmology
changeSet.comment: One ingest_item per distinct scan; link every job to its own.
changeSet.sql:
-- 1. Create the missing rows: one per (digest-or-path, scan index), -- seeded from the lowest job id so the choice is deterministic. WITH hints AS ( SELECT a.entity_id AS job_id, substring(a.old_value from 'patientId=([^;]*)') AS patient_id, NULLIF(substring(a.old_value from 'studySubjectId=([0-9]+)'), '')::int AS study_subject_id FROM audit_log_event a WHERE a.audit_log_event_type_id = 115 AND a.audit_table = 'retinal_inference_job' ), scans AS ( SELECT COALESCE(j.e2e_sha256, 'path:' || j.e2e_path) AS scan_key, j.scan_index, MIN(j.job_id) AS seed_job_id FROM retinal_inference_job j WHERE j.ingest_item_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ) INSERT INTO ingest_item ( kind, source_kind, stored_path, sha256, scan_index, laterality, acquisition_date, patient_id, candidate_study_subject_id, received_at, status, match_policy, bound_study_subject_id, bound_study_event_id, bound_event_crf_id, bound_at, status_message) SELECT 'e2e', 'portal-oct', j.e2e_path, j.e2e_sha256, j.scan_index, j.eye_laterality, j.acquisition_date, h.patient_id, -- The suggestion, not a decision: a subject the upload named -- is a hint until somebody confirms it. (SELECT ss.study_subject_id FROM study_subject ss WHERE ss.study_subject_id = h.study_subject_id), -- When the file actually arrived, not when this ran. j.enqueued_at, CASE WHEN j.study_event_id IS NOT NULL OR j.event_crf_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'BOUND' WHEN j.status = 'cancelled' THEN 'DISMISSED' ELSE 'UNBOUND' END, CASE WHEN j.study_event_id IS NOT NULL OR j.event_crf_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'backfill' ELSE NULL END, COALESCE( (SELECT se.study_subject_id FROM study_event se WHERE se.study_event_id = j.study_event_id), (SELECT ec.study_subject_id FROM event_crf ec WHERE ec.event_crf_id = j.event_crf_id)), COALESCE( j.study_event_id, (SELECT ec.study_event_id FROM event_crf ec WHERE ec.event_crf_id = j.event_crf_id)), j.event_crf_id, CASE WHEN j.study_event_id IS NOT NULL OR j.event_crf_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(j.completed_at, j.enqueued_at) ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN j.status = 'parked' THEN 'migrated from the parked retinal queue' ELSE NULL END FROM scans s JOIN retinal_inference_job j ON j.job_id = s.seed_job_id LEFT JOIN hints h ON h.job_id = j.job_id -- Skip anything already in the queue: the digest is the identity, -- and re-creating it would violate the dedup index. WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ingest_item ii WHERE ii.sha256 IS NOT NULL AND ii.sha256 = j.e2e_sha256 AND COALESCE(ii.scan_index, -1) = COALESCE(j.scan_index, -1)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ingest_item ii WHERE j.e2e_sha256 IS NULL AND ii.stored_path = j.e2e_path AND COALESCE(ii.scan_index, -1) = COALESCE(j.scan_index, -1));
-- 2. Point every job at the row for its scan. Matching on the same -- key the insert grouped by, so the sibling tasks of one scan all -- land on the same item. UPDATE retinal_inference_job j SET ingest_item_id = ii.ingest_item_id FROM ingest_item ii WHERE j.ingest_item_id IS NULL AND ii.kind = 'e2e' AND COALESCE(ii.scan_index, -1) = COALESCE(j.scan_index, -1) AND ( (j.e2e_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND ii.sha256 = j.e2e_sha256) OR (j.e2e_sha256 IS NULL AND ii.stored_path = j.e2e_path) );

changeSet.author: muw-ophthalmology
changeSet.comment: Parked jobs are superseded by their UNBOUND ingest_item.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE retinal_inference_job SET status = 'cancelled', status_message = 'migrated to ingest_item ' || ingest_item_id || ' (P3.3 — superseded by the unified inbox)' WHERE status = 'parked' AND ingest_item_id IS NOT NULL;

rollback.sql: UPDATE retinal_inference_job SET status = 'parked', status_message = NULL WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND status_message LIKE 'migrated to ingest_item %';

changeSet.author: muw-ophthalmology
changeSet.comment: Dedup on the scan's row rather than its digest; allow a re-run after a cancel.
